name: diamond-pack
_comment: restyle-back.cjs: the 151 back restyled to a graded front. Only the colours are per pack; the film level, sheen, grain and chroma are measured from the front by the tool.

palette._source: diamond-pack-front.webp. metal = median of the brightest 30% of the tier lettering box (150-780 x 1290-1383); pale = median of the brightest 25% of the logo box (285-550 x 705-1005); dark = median of the darkest 10% of the body
palette._decision: Owner decision 2026-11-19: band and odds outline in the front's blue (median of its chromatic hue-240 pixels); the neutral tier metal is variant "neutral".

_printHold: Accepted plate: its live zones already meet the print-area contrast target as printed, so the print-area hold stays off and the plate reproduces byte for byte.
